p: house at Ramah: That is, among his own kindred.
Maon: Maon and Carmel were cities in the tribe of Judah. Carmel the mountain was in Galilee.
to him that liveth in prosperity: Or, for salvation.
cometh to thine hand unto thy: Whatever you have ready for us.
son of Jesse: Thus the covetous wretches instead of relieving the needs of God's children, reviled their persons and condemned their cause.
unto us: When we kept our sheep in the wilderness of Paran.
husband Nabal: Because she knew his crooked nature, that he would rather die than agree to her enterprise.
pisseth against the wall: Meaning by this proverb that he would destroy both small and great.
hand: That is, that you should not be revenged by your enemy.
sure house: Confirm his kingdom to his posterity.
a man is risen to pursue: That is, Saul.
bundle of life with the LORD: God will preserve you long in his service, and destroy your enemies.
avenged himself: That he did not avenge himself, which would have tormented his conscience.
and from avenging myself with mine: Read 1Sa 25:31.
which hath kept me back from: He attributes it to the Lord's mercy, and not to himself that he was stayed.
nothing: For he had no reason either to consider, or to give thanks for this great benefit of deliverance.
a stone: For fear of the great danger.
take her to him to wife: For he had experienced her great godliness, wisdom and humility.
